title: feat(spec,console): ask_ai action type — focus the in-app assistant on a record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GQ6AcWeR72ieTBXyYMDAWk)_

Fixes #37142
Fixes #37276

## 维护者速读

- 做了什么：元数据作者可以在记录页放一个「问 AI」按钮（`type: 'ask_ai'`），点了就把站内助手对准这条记录并展开，不发消息、不调服务端。
- 为什么：专题 #36996 第 6 行，落实 ADR-0160 D7；前置 #36999（助手聚焦）已合。
- 风险：spec 新增一个动作类型（扩宽）；`target` 与 `ai.exposed: true` 写在它旁边会在解析时被拒；没有站内助手、或手上不是恰好一条记录（批量栏、相关列表工具栏、列表头未选或多选）时按钮不出现，而不是置灰。
- 要你做什么：暂无。等席位 L1 与 L2 契约审核（spec 面，fable 档）。

## What changes

ADR-0160 D7 — an action on one record that focuses the in-app assistant on that record and opens it.

**Spec (`@objectstack/spec`)**
- `ActionType` gains `ask_ai`. It is outside the target-required set: it takes no `target`.
- `ActionSchema` and `InlineActionSchema` refuse a `target` beside it (inline `to` too) at the `target` path, and `ai.exposed: true` at `ai.exposed` (`false` parses). `body` stays `script`-only.
- `DashboardHeaderActionSchema` refuses `actionType: 'ask_ai'` at `actionType`: a header runs on no record. `WidgetActionTypeSchema` stays derived from `ActionType`.
- Reference docs regenerated.

**Runtime (`@objectstack/runtime`)**
- `isHeadlessInvokableAction` answers `false` for `ask_ai`, so MCP `list_actions` skips it and the AI posture of the action door refuses it, whatever a stored row carries beside the type.
- `headlessActionTypeError` answers the REST door with a sentence about the in-app assistant instead of the generic "opens its `target`".

**Console**
- `@object-ui/core`: `ActionRunner` gets an `ask_ai` executor that hands `{ object, id }` to the installed `AssistantFocusHandler` (`setAssistantFocusHandler`) and nothing else: no registered handler, no fetch, no success toast unless `successMessage` is declared. The record is the row a row surface stashed (`recordIdField` honoured), else the page record, else the one selected row. No record, or several selected, is refused before any `confirmText`; so is a launch with no handler installed. `drawsAction()` answers whether an action is drawn; `ActionEngine.getActionsForLocation` and `getBulkActions` leave undrawn actions out. `isAskAiAction` reads `type` and the legacy `actionType`.
- `@object-ui/react`: `<ActionProvider onAskAi>` installs the handler (the latest one runs; the gate identity changes only when the handler appears or goes) and `useDrawsAction()` answers for every surface under it; with no provider, `ask_ai` is not drawn.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `useAskAiHandler` returns `dock.open({ agent, fresh: true })` + `setChatFocus(focus, { follow: true })` only when the layout hosts the chat drawer (`useChatDockControl`, which is null when the AI surface is off) and an agent in the catalog advertises `capabilities.focus` (`useAiSurfaceEnabled().focusServed`); the console action runtime passes it as `onAskAi`.
- **No single record ⇒ absent.** The bulk bar never offers an `ask_ai` action (the type of a promoted def is read off its `actionDef`); `ActionRunner.bulkRefusal` refuses a per-row run over a selection (the grid's per-record bulk dispatch asks it), and `ActionEngine.getBulkActions` / `executeBulk` leave it out. A list header draws it only while exactly one row is selected, and leaves it out (not greyed) with none or several. A related list's toolbar leaves it out, because a launch there runs on the parent; its rows still draw it.
- **The conversation it opens.** The click opens the drawer on a fresh thread of an agent that declares `capabilities.focus` (`focusAgentName`, an `ask` agent first), so the drawer's pin control, which asks the active agent, is drawn, and pins the record to that thread. `setChatFocus(focus, { follow: true })` (new option): a host showing a conversation keeps that conversation's focus and gives this one to the next conversation it shows; the first send carries it onto the id it mints, and an unsent fresh thread creates nothing.
- `resolveAiApiBase` moves to `hooks/aiApiBase.ts` (re-exported from `useAiSurface`), so `useAskAiHandler` does not import a module many layout tests mock.
- Every action surface asks `useDrawsAction()` beside its existing gates: record header/`DeclaredActionsBar`, `action:bar`, `action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group`, `action:menu`, element buttons, container action filters, grid row menu and actions column, data-table row actions, related-list toolbar, bulk action bar.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-ask-ai.test.ts`: member, parses with no target, refusals at `target` / `ai.exposed` (both in one parse), `ai.exposed: false` accepted, `body` refused, inline refusals, neighbours keep their rules.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard-header-ask-ai-37142.test.ts`: header refusal, vocabulary still derived, other types still accepted.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-ask-ai-headless.test.ts`: not headless-invokable (with or without automation, and for an at-rest row carrying `target`/`body`/`ai.exposed`), REST sentence.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.askAi-37142.test.ts`: click hands the record once and sends nothing (fetch stub, script handler, toast unspied), row / scoped / selected record readings, refusals before confirm, not drawn without a handler, `ActionEngine` filtering.
- `ui/packages/react/src/context/__tests__/ActionProvider.askAi-37142.test.tsx`: drawn only with `onAskAi`, gate identity, latest handler runs, no provider.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useAskAiHandler-37142.test.tsx`, `useAiSurface.test.ts` (`focusServed`), `views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.askAi-37142.test.tsx` (absent without assistant, drawn and focuses with one; ablation of the filter turns it red).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`: one table row and one sentence (164 → 165 lines); the token ratchet stays under its ceiling.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.askAi-37142.test.ts` adds `bulkRefusal`, `getBulkActions` / `executeBulk` and page-record `recordIdField`; `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/BulkActionBar.askAi-37142.test.tsx`, `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.toolbarAskAi-37142.test.tsx`, `app-shell/src/views/__tests__/objectViewHeaderLaunchGate.askAi-37142.test.tsx` pin the three no-single-record surfaces; `useAskAiHandler-37142` pins the agent it opens.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/chatFocus-36999.test.tsx` (objectstack#37142 block): the real dock body and focus host under a real `useAskAiHandler`; a drawer open on another conversation keeps that conversation's focus and the fresh thread's first send carries the record; a drawer on an unsent thread takes it at once. Ablated: without `follow`, and with `open({ agent })` instead of the fresh thread, the first case fails.
- The same block pins N4: after an `ask_ai` click, opening a history conversation before sending shows and sends that conversation's own focus (rec_9 kept), and a conversation with no focus gets none. Ablated: without the target key, both fail.
- Updated pins that enumerate `ActionType.options` (spec row-update, undoable, inline; Studio presets and type-switch pins).

## Acceptance notes

- Contract review N4 (an unsent fresh thread's carry lands on a history conversation picked before the first send; predates this PR, widened by it): filed as #37276 (claim 7160324153) and fixed here. `useConversationFocus` takes a key of the dock's target and drops a hand-off's carry when it changes, so only the id the target resolves, or the first send mints, takes the carried focus. A pending `follow` is kept across that change.
- Studio's action inspector does not offer `ask_ai` in its Type picker (its option list is hand-written); authoring is code / metadata only for now.
- `params` beside `ask_ai` are not refused (inert); a record-less location such as `list_toolbar` is not refused at parse — the action is absent there unless exactly one row is selected, and the runner refuses a launch that reaches it anyway.
- The global `ConsoleShell` action runtime sits above the chat dock, so `ask_ai` is absent there; per-view runtimes inside the layout get it. Direct `useActionRunner` owners get no handler, so `ask_ai` is absent for them.
- `form.tsx` (update-operation actions only) and the managed-by empty state are not gated.
- The dashboard-header refusal goes beyond the ADR's words; flagged for L2 (judged justified in record 7152689299).
- The SKILL.md row does not name the dashboard-header refusal (R7): adding it puts the file 14 tokens over its ratchet ceiling, so it is left to #37217.

## Verification

- `@objectstack/spec`: full suite 892 files / 28329 tests pass.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: typecheck pass; ask_ai + declarative-update tests pass.
- `@object-ui/core` 4789, `@object-ui/react` 1601, `@object-ui/components` 4966, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` 2783, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` 3941 tests pass; type-check passes on all six ui packages.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: hooks, console, metadata-admin, studio-design and `DeclaredActionsBar` tests pass (1204 files after the two pin fixes).
- Review round (R1–R6) and the three CI failures at `076ed686`: `@object-ui/core` 248 files / 4792 pass; plugin-grid `__tests__` + components 272 files pass; plugin-detail RelatedList / RecordRelatedListRenderer 73 files pass; app-shell layout + hooks + console/home 311 files pass, views 220 files pass; `@objectstack/example-showcase` 49 files / 554 pass; type-check passes on core, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, app-shell. New tests each turn red when their fix is removed (list header 3/3, bulk bar 1/1, related-list toolbar 1/1, and the two CI-red AppHeader files fail again with the old import).
- Gates derived by `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` for this change set (131 commands): all pass except three that could not measure in this container — `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needs an unshallow clone), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's `dist/`); `check:skill-examples` passed on a re-run once the spec build had finished. CI runs them in full.
- ESLint on every changed source and test file: 0 errors.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #37217

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
